name: [🏆] The Donation Game!
desc:
🏆 Welcome to KreekCraft's Official Donation Game! 🏆

As of May 29th, 2026, Roblox has officially stopped cross-game transactions. Our entire game relied on any user being able to donate to anyone, so this forced us to shut down. Thank you to all of our players who supported us. We genuinely couldn't have done it without you.
